diagnosticsLinkBody: Runtime daemon and system resource diagnostics are maintained in the Support surface so there is a single place for troubleshooting.
developerModeDescription: Developer Mode lets this production account approve isolated local-development projects. It grants no Nimi permission by itself. App-owned data needs no Nimi permission; protected access is evaluated separately when used.
developerModeStatusUnavailable: Developer Mode is unavailable until the fixed Nimi Runtime service is connected
